purpose: One newly registered serial eight-hour cold-start A capacity development gate. Preserve the v2 capacity failure unchanged; this is not continuation of that run or formal quality inference.

launch_prerequisites: All other model/full-fab/CP processes and their finalizers have terminated.
Root has independently reviewed and frozen exact source, input, vendor, requirements and runtime inventory.
The new target does not exist; preserve v2 and any failed v3 attempt without automatic retry.
Recheck free disk >=40GiB; capacity is neither reserved nor obtained by deleting prior evidence.
execution_constraints.external_timeout_action: Kill the sole child process group; preserve raw outputs and missing receipts as failure. No automatic rerun or enlarged allowance.
execution_constraints.bundle_readback_timeout_action: Stop the sole read-only verification subprocess on180-second timeout, record failed acceptance with elapsed outer wall and retain all original reports; no automatic retry.

budget_semantics.cp_total: 16 periodic boundaries 0,1800,...,27000 times 2 requested seconds =32; event plans request zero CP; no terminal CP request.
budget_semantics.wall: Runner and actual child elapsed wall must both be <=5400 seconds at final acceptance; the independent outer watchdog is 6000 seconds. Full final audit/checkpoint/hash costs remain charged; boundary checks are not per-instruction preemption. The frozen read_bundle storage subprocess has a separate180-second timeout; its entire cost remains part of outer wall and never resets the main child budget.
budget_semantics.constructor: 5-second soft algorithm limit and 250000 candidate evaluations per event plan; preprocessing and nominal checks can exceed the soft timer. Actual wall remains charged.
budget_semantics.plans: At most1200 attempted planner calls, including failures; preserve all reservations/finishes and explicit plan responses.
budget_semantics.trace: New registered 2GiB cap, checked at runner admission/finalization and by gate; complete raw events retained.
budget_semantics.logs: 16GiB final combined campaign and run evidence, including frozen source, stdout/stderr, bundle, snapshot, all problems/results and acceptance. Any final overshoot fails and is retained.
budget_semantics.peak_rss: Same child PID records resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss in try/finally: macOS raw bytes, Linux raw KiB. Final measured peak must be <=8GiB. Missing/unsupported/invalid receipt fails. This is post-run measurement, not a hard memory guard or total process-tree/parent RSS bound.

prior_run.outcome: Failed at original256MiB trace cap; no retroactive acceptance or changed budget.

algorithm_scope: Same A hybrid parameters as v2. Changes are run identity, declared wall/disk/memory capacity, streaming saved-trace audit and streaming encoding of unchanged snapshot-1 state. This does not integrate the disk-backed trace prototype.
acceptance: Runner success, complete terminal t=28800, full_window_completed, model_calls0, formalfalse.

Frozen read_bundle storage readback verifies every member hash; three independent source/opportunity/physical summaries valid and source report declares all913 production machines. Input receipt binds complete raw trace and exact frozen dependency hashes.
Only six primary metrics are mirrored in result; all metric fields remain in hash-bound audit_bundle/metrics.json.
At most1200 plans, CP requested<=32 and16 periodic plans; exact saved resource inheritance; actual physical checkpoint retained and hashed, without asserting restoration was tested by this gate.
Child wall<=5400, outer wall<=6000, trace<=2GiB, all evidence<=16GiB and measured child peakRSS<=8GiB. Missing measurements or overshoot fail.
Preserve full errors/raw files; final gate acceptance is required independently of runner success.

Carry the verified audit manifest SHA, all six member SHAs and complete raw trace receipt SHA unchanged into final evidence collection; any mismatch fails the current attempt. Successful acceptance replay performs the same final binding without re-anchoring changed files.
limitations: Source report JSON is fully parsed by gate for exact top-level coverage fields; this is not a bounded-memory long-window audit gate.
Environment trace, metric intervals and physical report arrays remain in RAM; snapshot reader remains legacy. No7/14/28-day readiness or steady-state/official calibration claim.
read_bundle is storage verification of previously completed semantic reports, not semantic re-execution. Gate does not certify model authorship or restored snapshot equivalence.
stopping: Any failed/interrupted attempt is retained with its original bounds. No automatic retry, model call, reference fallback, cancellation, new run ID or capacity increase.

implementation_verification.note: Synthetic tests only. Final exact source/runtime freeze occurs after root review.
